notes.title: CONSCRIPT Beta v0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
•	Base pixel resolution is now 480x270, meaning you can now see more onscreen at any time. UI elements have been resized accordingly. 
•	Default movement speed is now a jog. If playing with a controller, you can still walk by lightly moving the analogue stick.  
•	New sprinting and stamina mechanic. This was implemented due to the overall faster pace of combat.
•	Health bar and stamina bar on screen. 
•	Player exhaust state if stamina is used up. This leaves the player more vulnerable. 
•	Jogging is now the default speed. 
•	Enemy AI improvements.
•	New items and equipment.
•	Level design of front lines has been reworked. It is now a little bit smaller and more concise.
•	New frontline setpieces and progression.
•	New smoother collision system that should reduce the frequency of getting stuck on corners.
•	Explosions!
•	Restore defaults option implemented. 
•	Red explosive barrels implemented.
•	Many bug fixes and improvements. 
•	Ambience volume adjustment is now an option. 
•	Various UI & UX improvements such as displaying the amount of pages when reading a note. 
•	Merchant Implemented! Trade cigarettes for items, and upgrade weapons with gun parts.
•	Valuable treasures can be found to trade with the merchant.
•	Reticule system. Focused shots have increased accuracy and will make the enemy flinch. 
•	Unlimited saves and checkpoints option. 
•	New soundtrack and upgraded sound design. 
•	Upgraded map system that displays more detail. 
•	Tutorial barrels inform players they are breakable.
•	Many bug fixes and improvements. 
•	+ more.
